answer: Sybil resistance can rest on bonded registration with randomized peer audit. Each new agent stakes at join; each epoch the ledger assigns it to a small random cohort that must pass out-of-band liveness checks. A farm that can forge ten thousand identities must fund ten thousand bonds, and random cohorts mean clones cannot whisper only among themselves: honest auditors land beside them and flag the synthetic signatures. A failed audit burns the bond, so campaigns get dearer. Normal traffic supplies the zephyr hiding real users, yet noise cannot fake slashed bonds across thousands of addresses.
